description: Replacement of the item by a new or refurbished item of the same type and make
Manual maintenance action performed to restore an item to its original appearance or state
examples: Repack, weld, plug, reconnect, remake, etc.

description: Replace, renew or change the item, or a part of it, with an item/part of a different type, make, material or design
examples: Install a filter with smaller mesh diameter; replace a lubrication oil pump with another type; reconfiguration

description: Bringing any out-of-tolerance condition into tolerance
examples: Align, set and reset, calibrate, balance

description: Minor repair/servicing activity to bring back an item to an acceptable appearance, internal and external
examples: Polish, clean, grind, paint, coat, lube, oil change

description: Cause of the failure is investigated, but no maintenance action performed, or action is deferred. Able to regain function by simple actions.
examples: Restart, resetting, no maintenance action; particularly relevant for functional failures (e.g., fire & gas detectors, subsea equipment)

description: Periodic service tasks; normally no dismantling of the item
examples: Cleaning, replenishment of consumables, adjustments and calibrations

description: Periodic test of function or performance
examples: Function test of gas detector; accuracy test of flow meter

description: Periodic inspection/check: a careful scrutiny of an item carried out with or without dismantling, normally by use of senses
examples: All types of general check; includes minor servicing as part of the inspection task

description: Major overhaul with extensive disassembly and replacement of items as specified or required
Several of the above activities are included; if one activity dominates, this may alternatively be recorded
Maintenance activity other than specified above
